# GKO Model Code Map (blocks vs. code addresses)

**Model:** `model/COSIM.m2630opt.Jul1599`  
**Generated by:** `code_map.py`  
**Method:** every store cell is attributed to the block of the slot it writes (slot name `GKO.<BLOCK>.<...>`); `bucketed` = 4 KiB code buckets, `region` = init / per-cycle #2 / per-cycle #3.

## 2. Block -> code ranges

## 5. Naming note

Slot `0x8040` (call block +0x40, the **assert message offset**) is named `GKO.DMM.KSKP_BITS.BIT0.L1`, so the assert-report cells that write it are attributed to the DMM block.  This is why per-cycle #2 looks DMM-dominated (39%): most of those stores are the per-cycle assert/report writes, not MMU logic.
